At Advect revision d5f4bae154f040f1e80c32dc7c1aab41e4c155dc (HEAD rechecked), input-based detection is feasible without coupling treams to one concrete Advect tracer class.

Source-confirmed facts:

  • Public recognition: advect.is_traced(value) checks whether _advect_snapshot is callable, without reading the trace payload. It explicitly checks only the value itself, not nested containers. Exported from root advect. Implementation, export.
  • Multiple tracer implementations: NumPy dynamic values use TracedArray; non-NumPy Array API dynamic values use ArrayAPITracer; staged AbstractArray also implements _advect_snapshot. Detecting only advect.numpy.TracedArray would miss supported Advect representations. NumPy tracer, Array API tracer, staged snapshot.
  • Array namespace is not an autodiff identifier: NumPy-backed TracedArray.__array_namespace__() returns the underlying NumPy namespace. Thus namespace equality cannot distinguish an Advect-traced NumPy value from ordinary NumPy. Implementation. Non-NumPy ArrayAPITracer instead returns an Advect namespace proxy. Implementation.
  • NumPy protocols intercept operations, not arbitrary Rust functions: TracedArray implements __array_ufunc__ and __array_function__, forwarding through Advect’s operation handlers. These protocols alone do not select treams’ analytic derivative rule for a foreign native call. ufunc and function dispatch.
  • Construction can preserve traces: Public advect.asarray handles direct tracers and rectangular nested tracer sequences, assembling traced sequences with namespace operations. Ordinary untraced values retain their Array API provider or default to NumPy. Contract and implementation. This demonstrates why dispatch must precede unconditional np.asarray; the non-NumPy Array API tracer explicitly rejects __array__ conversion. Rejection.
  • Ambient tracing detection is private: core._context.is_tracing() recognizes both dynamic and staging traces, but root advect and advect.core do not export it. A transparent treams implementation should not depend on it. Internal function, public core exports. Public transform_state supplies invocation-scoped bookkeeping, not a portable backend-choice contract. Contract.

At pinned treams-rs revision fcf62400700e326ffcc61ec50025cb25ea43ea6d:

  • The existing adapter already supplies the necessary Rust derivative boundary: an @ad.primitive(..., residual=True) forward stores the native pullback, and def_transpose invokes it. Dispatch can reuse this implementation. Primitive.
  • Its convention is dL = Re(vdot(gradient, dx)); no conjugation is applied, and scalar-gradient reshaping is enabled. _operation normalizes inputs using ad.numpy.asarray before primitive leaf flattening, packs native outputs as complex128, and takes the real part for declared real outputs. Transpose, operation.
  • Physical constructors are already bound to one shared Constructors implementation with Backend(ad.numpy, _operation). Binding.
  • Adapter support remains CPU, first-order reverse differentiation only; forward mode, higher derivatives, staging and checkpointing are explicitly unavailable. Recognizing a staged Advect tracer must not be reported as adding staging support. Documented contract.
  • Shared framework Material retains framework values. Its as_material can extract values from an existing root Material, but that cannot restore a trace already coerced away. Material conversion.
  • Framework objects currently require identical backend objects when composing. Automatic constructor selection therefore still needs a bounded constant-object conversion policy or an explicit calculation-wide selection; dispatch alone does not fix constant NumPy objects mixed with framework objects. Backend identity check.

Inference: lazy detection can consult sys.modules.get("advect") and its public is_traced only when Advect is already loaded, then import treams_rs.advect on the first actual dispatch. An Advect tracer normally implies Advect is already imported. Inspect supported list/tuple/material fields before coercion; avoid arbitrary object-graph discovery and private tracer payloads. Plain NumPy inputs—including constant-only calls inside a differentiated function—provide no backend signal.

No runtime probes were executed in this subtask; these findings come from pinned source and reuse of the previous investigation’s excerpts.

Implemented autograd.py and focused tests.

  • Reuses shared constructors and native pullbacks; one primitive registration handles all differentiated arguments.
  • Preserves complex cotangent conventions, nested containers, real-to-complex promotion and repeated pullbacks.
  • Verified: 14 adapter tests, 7 Autograd lattice tests, 3 transparent receiver tests; Ruff and Pyrefly pass.
  • Limits: CPU, float64/complex128, first-order reverse differentiation. Forward mode and higher derivatives reject explicitly.

No installs, commits, pushes or shared-file edits.

items.html:
One concrete correctness issue:

  • Complex nested inputs lose values or fail in lpmv. _special_functions.py:104 uses np.iscomplexobj(z) when the original input lacks .dtype. For z=[complex_tracer], Autograd silently discards the result’s imaginary part; JAX JIT raises TracerArrayConversionError. Reproduced with z=0.4+0.2j: ordinary result [-1.18126393-0.46323263j], Autograd traced result [-1.18126393]. Determine complexity without coercing tracer containers and add nested-complex regression tests.

No other concrete issues found in the reviewed detection, Material, cotangent and lazy-import paths. A fresh-process probe confirmed ordinary NumPy calls load none of Advect, JAX, PyTorch or Autograd. No edits made.

Optimized _dispatch.py with current-import fast exit and cheap handling of constant NumPy physics objects. Added a loaded-framework regression test.

  • No frameworks loaded: five sphere cases pass; interface/slab remain 10.2–10.3% slower, adding 1.3–1.9 µs.
  • All four loaded: remaining overhead is 15.6–79.6%, adding 3.1–14.8 µs.
  • Verified: 214 transparent tests, six targeted tests, Ruff and Pyrefly pass.

Results: treams-dispatch-perf-agent.json and treams-dispatch-perf-loaded-agent.json. Source frozen; no commits.
